main_text.l: Latinè, emendatior quàm in primâ editione.

materiam Canonum, alter verò consonantiam & discre-
pantiam inter utrumque declarat, è MS. exemplari Guilelmi Blueti in Senatu Parif. Advocati, nunc primùm editi.
IN APPENDICE TOMI
I.
Martini Bracarensis Episcopi Collectio Orientalium Cano-
num, adscriptis ad margines tum variis lectionibus, tum
fontibus ex quibus Canones illi deprom500pti sunt, curâ &
studio Joan. Doviatii sacrorum canonum Professoris
Regii, nunc primùm edita.
Crisconii Episcopi Africani alterum opus, quod liber cano-
num, seu concordiæ canonum inscribitur, in quo integri Conciliorum canones &
Pontificum decreta referuntur. Ex codice MS. Bibliothecæ Claromontanæ Societatis Iesu, nunc primùm editum.

page.notes: Page is a single text column; the printed page number 446 and running head HISTORIA are at the top. Some words are blurred in the scan (e.g. "Pontificum", "Crisconium"); the word "depromptí" in the Doviatii sentence is partly obscured and was read as "depromptì sunt"; the line "deprom500pti" contains a misread artefact and should read "depromptì" [?]. Signature at lower right reads roughly "I ɜ" [?].
